# Harmonious Seasons (tree sprites)

Source: `docs/HarmoniousSeasons-ASeasonsBased2DPixelArtPack.zip` (branch `main`).
Pack: *Harmonious Seasons - A Seasons Based 2D Pixel Art Pack*.

Extracted green (normal) tree sprites, one file per tree, cropped to the opaque area:
- `bigger_1..5.png`: tall trees (about 80 x 127 px).
- `big_1..5.png`: medium trees (about 60 x 90 px).
- `small_1..5.png`: undergrowth trees (about 32 x 48 px).
